data.title: A distribution hub that stopped improvising at peak
data.summary: An Ayutthaya distribution centre integrated conveyors, sortation, and WES events to stabilise peak throughput.
data.challenge: Conveyor and sortation controls were commissioned separately from the warehouse system. At peak, exceptions were resolved by radio and manual re-scanning.
data.strategy: We designed an exception-first integration model: every scan, divert, and failure had one owner and one visible state. The team rehearsed peak scenarios before the season.
data.implementation: A middleware layer connected the WES and PLCs with replayable events. Operator screens showed blocked lanes and exception queues, and a peak control room was added for the eight busiest weeks.
